scenes.narration: A stack of one billion dollar bills is taller than where space begins.
One bill is about a tenth of a millimeter thick.
A million of them make a tower a hundred and nine meters tall. Higher than the Statue of Liberty.
A billion? Past Everest. Past the planes. A hundred and nine kilometers.
Space begins at a hundred. The stack goes right through it.
And a trillion would reach over a quarter of the way to the Moon. How much is a billion to you?
